title: leucas mollissima var. angustifolia
intro: Leucas mollissima var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Wild Basil, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Leucas mollissima var. angustifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing pain, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative, diuretic, and expectorant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds.
